title: ForcedLeak: prompt injection in Salesforce Agentforce exfiltrates CRM data
summary: Researchers showed that instructions planted in the description field of a Salesforce Web-to-Lead form could be executed by Agentforce when the agent later processed the lead. The injected instructions made the agent load an image from a domain that was still on the content security allowlist but had expired, which the researchers bought, carrying CRM data out in the request. Reported on 28 July 2025, fixed on 8 September and disclosed on 25 September.
attack_vector: Indirect prompt injection via public web-form input, with exfiltration through an allowlisted but expired domain
root_cause: Untrusted form input was treated as instructions in the agent's context, and the outbound allowlist contained a domain the vendor no longer controlled
impact: Customer contact information, sales pipeline data and internal communications in the CRM could be exfiltrated
mitigations_applied: Trusted URL enforcement for agent output (8 September 2025) and the expired domain re-secured
